title: File:EDT Surface of EN AW-5182 Aluminum Sheet – Confocal Laser and 3D Visualization.png
desc:
Visualization of the EDT surface structure on an EN AW-5182 aluminum sheet (manufacturer: Hydro).
Left: microscopic image captured using confocal laser microscopy.
Right: corresponding 3D height map based on laser topography measurement.
The images were taken on October 29, 2024, using the Keyence V
